QuestInfo.name: [RED] Move to the Beat
QuestInfo.0: Find a Treasure Chest that has its own pulse, and start your exciting journey.
QuestInfo.1: It's time to hunt down #e#bBeating Treasure Chests#k#n! The maps to these exotic treasures are usually hidden near deposits of ores and herbs. Dig them up to collect #e#b20 #t3994856##ks#n, and take them to Cassandra.
QuestInfo.2: Cassandra analyzed the map pieces to give you the location of a very special chest. But you'll have to hurry! If you don't make it in 30 minutes, #bsomeone else could steal the chest#k!

0.0: #b#h0##k! Have you heard the beat? Beating Treasure Chests, I mean! They're popping up all over Maple World right now, and they are just full of cool stuff. You wanna help me find one?

yes.0: This is gonna be so exciting! First things first, go harvest some herbs or mine some ore. I've heard that's where people have been finding bits of #b#eTreasure Map#k#n. I bet with about #b#e20 of those#k#n, we can make map. Next stop, profit!\r\n#i3994856# #t3994856# x 20
